description: Your company catalog, the best first call for "what companies do I have". Your list ("your_list"): every company in your daily reports, plus what the accounts you track discovered in the last 30 days. Plus a one-time starter set of the last 30 days of companies in your sectors ("starter") so a new account is never empty. Each row has tracked_followers (how many of your tracked accounts follow it): sort by it to find what your accounts are converging on. Filter by sector, since, q or source.

since.description: Only companies flagged since: "7d", "48h" or an ISO date

source.description: Only your own list, or only the starter set

name: frontrun_companies
